title: Living the Life
subtitle: Daily acts that earn purity
text: Purity comes from steady play: sleep while Hemolysis is active, kill hemomantic creatures or undead, breed animals, plant crops, heal tamed companions, and earn advancements. XP pickup, planting, pet healing, and empty-blood rewards have cooldowns, so repeating one action rapidly will not carry the path. Abstaining from blood manipulation grants a measured reward every five minutes. Observances and Altar offerings are the faster deliberate route.
